svg.title: Tree splits and impurity
svg.desc: Illustrative SVG examples of expected explanation and interactive cards. Each interactive scene shows one possible state.

g.text: Rabbit Hole · Decision Trees and Random Forests

g.aria-label: How a Tree Chooses Its First Split
g.text: How a Tree Chooses Its First Split
A tree compares candidate questions and picks the one with the biggest
drop in impurity. It repeats that search within each resulting branch.
Choose an applicant to follow their answers through the loan tree.
The highlighted branch leads to the decision.
Both measures rise as a group becomes more evenly mixed.
Entropy measures uncertainty in bits. Gini measures label mixing.
Move the cutoff to send points to either child and compare the gains.
The cutoff with the greatest gain leaves the children least mixed.
